protocol.development_basis: NumPy projection experiments on the already-used development probes recovered 8/8 reference-positive top timing peaks at 4096 bins, versus 7/8 at 2048 bins. This is not an untouched holdout.
protocol.scope: Projected pilot-power timing proposals, native-rate local power refinement, blind CFO acquisition and original-20ms FP64 fractional GLRT confirmation
algorithm_changes: All available original-rate frames are folded using independently rounded physical frame offsets. The native folded phase grid and template power are circular-linearly projected to 4096 bins for the proposal correlation only.
Each retained proposal is locally refined using original-rate folded power, including the circular seam; fractional GLRT still uses original IQ.
Single-candidate and two-candidate variants are separate detectors. No power threshold is fitted to these development probes.

Complex limited-range compilation omits overflow-recovery paths for bounded finite inputs; it does not enable general fast-math or reassociation. Desktop/ARM parity and controls must still be checked.
